# meltcloud_foundry (Data Source)

The [Foundry](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/nest/overview#foundry) is the meltcloud management plane that runs on the Nest. Needs the API Key of the admin Organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meltcloud_foundry" "this" {}

output "foundry_version" {
  value = data.meltcloud_foundry.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `auth0_config` (Attributes) The Auth0 tenant users sign in through. Null when none is set (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth0_config))
- `ha_topology` (String) [High availability](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/nest/high-availability) mode of the Foundry: `none` for Single Instance, `host` for Multi-instance, `zone` for Multi-zone. [Enable high availability](https://docs.meltcloud.io/tasks/foundry/enable-high-availability) in the admin area
- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the Foundry on meltcloud
- `identity_provider` (String) How users sign in: `auth0` through an Auth0 tenant, or `dummy`, which signs everyone in as admin, for trials only
- `letsencrypt_config` (Attributes) Certificates from Let's Encrypt (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--letsencrypt_config))
- `rails_log_level` (String) Log level of the Foundry application (web and worker)
- `sentry_config` (Attributes) Error reporting to Sentry (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sentry_config))
- `status` (String) Status of the Foundry, for example `ready` or `updating`
- `version` (String) The Foundry version it runs

<a id="nestedatt--auth0_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth0_config`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the Auth0 application
- `domain` (String) Domain of the Auth0 tenant


<a id="nestedatt--letsencrypt_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `letsencrypt_config`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address Let's Encrypt sends expiry notices to
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Foundry hostnames get Let's Encrypt certificates
- `staging` (Boolean) Whether the Let's Encrypt staging environment is used


<a id="nestedatt--sentry_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sentry_config`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether errors of the Foundry application are reported to Sentry
- `environment` (String) Environment the errors are reported under
